name: @unicorn.eth/autoconnect
description: Drop-in Unicorn wallet integration for existing web3 apps. Works alongside your existing wallet setup (RainbowKit, Wagmi, Web3Modal, etc.) without modifying any code.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.js --format cjs,esm --external react,react-dom,wagmi,thirdweb && cp src/types/index.d.ts dist/index.d.ts
scripts.local:pack: pnpm run build && rm -rf .local-pkg && mkdir -p .local-pkg && npm pack --pack-destination .local-pkg --silent && tar -xzf .local-pkg/*.tgz -C .local-pkg && rm .local-pkg/*.tgz
scripts.local:link: pnpm run local:pack && pnpm --filter unicorn-autoconnect-basic-example run local:link && pnpm --filter @unicorn.eth/autoconnect-web3modal-example run local:link
scripts.local:unlink: pnpm --filter unicorn-autoconnect-basic-example run local:unlink && pnpm --filter @unicorn.eth/autoconnect-web3modal-example run local:unlink

author: Unicorn.eth
